sections.title: ① Full System Design
sections.body:
```python
"""
COMPLETE PRODUCTION RAG SYSTEM — Quick Reference for Interviews

Components and their recommended implementations:

1. DOCUMENT INGESTION
   ─────────────────────────────────────
   PDF:          docling (vision-transformer, best quality)
   HTML/Web:     Playwright + BeautifulSoup (JS-rendered pages)
   DOCX/PPTX:   python-docx / python-pptx
   OCR:          pytesseract or Azure Form Recognizer
   Queue:        Apache Kafka (large scale) or AWS SQS

2. CHUNKING
   ─────────────────────────────────────
   Default:      RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter(512, overlap=50)
   Semantic:     SemanticChunker (sentence similarity breakpoints)
   Hierarchical: ParentDocumentRetriever (small child + large parent)

3. EMBEDDING MODELS
   ─────────────────────────────────────
   Commercial:   OpenAI text-embedding-3-large (3072-dim, best quality)
   Open-source:  BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 (self-hosted, strong)
   Multilingual: BAAI/bge-m3 (100+ languages)

4. VECTOR DATABASE
   ─────────────────────────────────────
   Production:   Qdrant (best filtering, open-source)
   Managed:      Pinecone (zero-ops, enterprise SLA)
   Multi-modal:  Weaviate
   Config:       HNSW(m=16, ef_construct=200), Scalar quantization

5. RETRIEVAL
   ─────────────────────────────────────
   Default:      Hybrid (BM25 + dense) with RRF fusion
   Augmented:    Multi-query for complex/ambiguous queries
   Precise:      HyDE for short/technical queries

6. RERANKING
   ─────────────────────────────────────
   Commercial:   Cohere Rerank v3 (highest quality)
   Open-source:  BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 (best open-source)
   Fast:         cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2

7. GENERATION
   ─────────────────────────────────────
   Primary:      GPT-4o (best quality)
   Budget:       GPT-4o-mini (3x faster, 10x cheaper)
   Self-hosted:  Llama 3.1 70B via vLLM
   Temperature:  0 for factual RAG

8. CACHING
   ─────────────────────────────────────
   Exact:        Redis (query hash → answer)
   Semantic:     Custom (query embedding similarity + Redis for storage)
   LLM:          LangChain InMemoryCache / Redis cache

9. EVALUATION
   ─────────────────────────────────────
   Framework:    RAGAS (faithfulness, answer_relevancy, precision, recall)
   Thresholds:   faithfulness > 0.88, answer_relevancy > 0.85
   CI/CD:        Fail merge if any metric drops > 0.05 from baseline
   LLM judge:    GPT-4o for custom criteria evaluation

10. MONITORING
    ─────────────────────────────────────
    Tracing:     LangSmith (free dev, paid prod)
    Infra:       Prometheus + Grafana
    Alerts:      PagerDuty (P99 > 3s, error rate > 1%, faithfulness < 0.85)
    Logging:     Structured JSON logs → Datadog or ELK stack
"""

# One-liner summary for interview:
SYSTEM_SUMMARY = """
Production RAG = 
  Docling parsing → 
  Recursive chunking (512/50) → 
  BGE/OpenAI embeddings → 
  Qdrant (HNSW + payload filter) → 
  Hybrid retrieval (BM25 + dense + RRF) → 
  Cohere reranker → 
  LCEL chain + GPT-4o (T=0) → 
  Redis semantic cache → 
  Streaming SSE response → 
  LangSmith tracing + RAGAS evaluation
"""
```

diagrams.title: Production RAG system design
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  subgraph ING["Ingestion workers"]
    Q1["queue"] --> W["parse, chunk, embed"]
  end
  W --> VDB[("vector DB + BM25 index")]
  API["API gateway — auth, rate limit"] --> CACHE{"semantic cache"}
  CACHE -- "miss" --> ORCH["RAG orchestrator"]
  ORCH --> VDB
  ORCH --> RR["reranker service"]
  ORCH --> LLMGW["LLM gateway — routing, retries, fallback"]
  ORCH --> OBS["tracing + metrics"]
  CACHE -- "hit" --> API
diagrams.explain: Separate **ingestion** (async workers) from **serving**. The serving path adds a semantic cache in front, a reranker service, and an LLM gateway for routing, retries and fallbacks. Everything emits traces and metrics so quality and cost stay visible.

sections.title: ④ Complete Architecture Visual
sections.body:
```
COMPLETE PRODUCTION RAG REFERENCE ARCHITECTURE
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

INGESTION PIPELINE (Async, Parallel)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[Document Sources]
  S3 Bucket / SharePoint / Web URLs / Databases
       │ trigger (S3 event / webhook)
       ▼
  [Message Queue - Kafka/SQS]
       │ consumed by N workers
       ▼
  [Ingestion Workers (K8s pods, autoscaled)]
  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  1. Parse (Docling/Unstructured)            │
  │  2. Clean (dedup, strip boilerplate)        │
  │  3. PII mask (Presidio)                     │
  │  4. Chunk (Recursive 512/50)                │
  │  5. Embed (BGE / text-embedding-3-large)    │
  │  6. Validate (self-retrieval test)          │
  └─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
       │
       ▼ batch upsert (200 vectors/request)
  [Qdrant Cluster]
  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  Collection: rag_index                      │
  │  Index: HNSW (m=16, ef_construct=200)       │
  │  Quantization: Scalar INT8 (4x smaller)     │
  │  Payload indices: tenant_id, date, source   │
  │  Replicas: 3 (HA)  Shards: 4 (scale)        │
  └─────────────────────────────────────────────┘

QUERY PIPELINE (P95 < 2s SLA)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
User Query
    │
    ▼ [FastAPI — Load Balanced]
  JWT Auth (tenant_id, clearance extracted)
    │
    ▼ [Redis Semantic Cache]
  ┌─ Cache HIT (20-40% of traffic) ──→ Return cached answer (< 10ms)
  │
  └─ Cache MISS
       │
       ▼ [Query Processing — LCEL]
  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  1. Query classification (complex/simple)   │
  │  2. Multi-query expansion (if complex)      │
  │  3. HyDE (if technical/short query)         │
  └─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
       │
       ▼ [Hybrid Retrieval]
  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  BM25 (sparse) ──┐                         │
  │                   ├→ RRF fusion → top-20   │
  │  Dense ANN ───────┘  + tenant filter       │
  └─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
       │
       ▼ [Cohere Reranker v3]
  top-20 → top-5 (highest quality)
       │
       ▼ [LCEL Generation Chain]
  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  System prompt (grounding rules)            │
  │  Context (5 chunks, citations formatted)    │
  │  User question                              │
  │  → GPT-4o (T=0) → streaming tokens         │
  └─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
       │ tokens stream via SSE
       ▼
  User sees answer token-by-token ✓

OBSERVABILITY (Always On)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Every query → LangSmith trace (input, output, latency, cost)
  Every hour  → RAGAS sample evaluation (1% of traffic)
  Every merge → CI/CD RAGAS gate (500 test cases)
  Always      → Prometheus metrics → Grafana dashboard
  Threshold   → PagerDuty alert (P99 > 3s or faithfulness < 0.85)
```
